content: Nearly all men can stand adversity, but if you want to test a man's character, give him power.
author: Abraham Lincoln
story:
Preserved as part of Abraham Lincoln's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of power and leadership. Across his life and work, Abraham Lincoln returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
